citations.quote: The annual home-office allowance for employees is INR 12000.
The annual home-office allowance for employees is INR 15000.

reason: 2 Approved Atlas/employee policies are in force on 2026-09-21 for HOME_OFFICE and state different amounts: INR 12000, INR 15000. The corpus cannot be resolved without human review.

issues.message: Two or more policies in force for this caller state different amounts, so no single limit can be quoted.
issues.detail: Conflicting amounts 12000, 15000 from atlas-home-office-a, atlas-home-office-b. A human must decide which passage governs.

issues.message: An annual policy limit does not establish remaining balance or expense eligibility.
issues.detail: The figure quoted is the annual cap only. Year-to-date usage, the remaining balance, and whether this particular expense qualifies are all outside the policy corpus and must be confirmed separately.

issues.message: Whether the specific expense claimed is eligible under the quoted policy has not been determined and requires human assessment.

decision_note: This service returns policy information only. It does not approve, deny, or pay claims, and no payment is ever initiated.
